# Insert Into Set — new element

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Set insertion preserves exact element type and reports whether the element was already included. Repeated insertion does not duplicate it.

## What this example demonstrates

Set insertion preserves exact element type and reports whether the element was already included. Repeated insertion does not duplicate it.
